t.zh: 最近邻缩放只会照抄，新像素的值只能是原图里已有的某一个。这一关的问题是：新像素落在两个旧像素之间时，它只能等于其中一个吗？这一关的图都只有一行。
t.en: Nearest-neighbour resizing only copies: a new pixel can only take a value the original already has. This level asks: when a new pixel falls between two old ones, must it equal one of them? This level's images are all one row high.

t.zh: 测试要的是：[0, 1] 放大成 3 像素时，中间那个是 0.5。新像素的值由它左右两个旧像素决定，离得越近的那个说了算的越多。
t.en: The tests want [0, 1] enlarged to 3 pixels to have 0.5 in the middle. A new pixel's value is decided by the old pixels on its left and right, the nearer one counting for more.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽 w、高 h，输出缩放后的图：每个新像素由左右两个旧像素按距离加权
desc.en: Takes an image and a new width w and height h; gives the resized image, each new pixel weighted from the old pixels to its left and right by distance

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：权重之和为 1，新值介于两边之间。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: the weights sum to 1 and the new value lies between the two.

brief.zh: 输入一行像素和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，新像素由左右两个旧像素按距离加权。
brief.en: Given a row of pixels and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel weighted from its two old neighbours by distance.

hint.zh: 先找出新位置左边那个旧像素，再算新位置离它有多远。
hint.en: First find the old pixel to the left of the new position, then how far the position is from it.

hint.zh: 两端的新位置落在原图之外：取像素可以设成取最近的边。
hint.en: The new positions at the ends fall outside the original: the lookup can be set to read the nearest edge.
